lit: The slower you ride, the farther you'll get.
en: Slow and steady wins the race.

ru: Не всё то золото, что блестит
say: nye fsyo to zólata, shto blyestít
lit: Not everything that glitters is gold.

ru: Без труда не выловишь и рыбку из пруда
say: byez trudá nye výlavish' i rýpku iz prudá
lit: Without effort you can't even pull a little fish out of a pond.

ru: Семь раз отмерь — один раз отрежь
say: syem' ras atmyér' — adín ras atryézh
lit: Measure seven times, cut once.

ru: Волков бояться — в лес не ходить
say: valkóf bayát'sya — v lyes nye khadít'
lit: If you're afraid of wolves, don't go into the forest.

ru: Любишь кататься — люби и саночки возить
say: lyúbish' katát'sya — lyubí i sánachki vazít'
lit: If you love sledding, love pulling the sled back up too.
en: If you want the fun, accept the work that comes with it.

lit: The morning is wiser than the evening.
What you sow is what you'll reap.
Better late than never.
There's no bad without some good.
en: Every cloud has a silver lining.

lit: Friends are known in times of trouble.
en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

ru: В гостях хорошо, а дома лучше
say: v gastyákh kharashó, a dóma lúchshe
lit: It's nice visiting, but it's better at home.
Appetite comes while eating.
en: Once you get started, you want more.

ru: Не откладывай на завтра то, что можно сделать сегодня
say: nye atkládyvay na záftra to, shto mózhna zdyélat' syevódnya
lit: Don't put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
Speech is silver, silence is gold.
en: Sometimes it's wiser to say nothing.

ru: Кто рано встаёт, тому Бог подаёт
say: kto rána fstayót, tamú bokh padayót
lit: God gives to the one who gets up early.
en: The early bird catches the worm.

lit: The apple doesn't fall far from the apple tree.

ru: Не имей сто рублей, а имей сто друзей
say: nye iméy sto rubléy, a iméy sto druzyéy
lit: Don't have a hundred rubles — have a hundred friends.
en: Friends are worth more than money.

ru: На вкус и цвет товарищей нет
say: na fkus i tsvyet tavárishchyey nyet
lit: In taste and color, there are no comrades.
We'll live and we'll see.
Moscow wasn't built all at once.
en: Rome wasn't built in a day.

lit: A time for work, an hour for fun.
